visual_review.description: Night-time photograph of busy fair entrance with illuminated boat-shaped sculptural decoration above the gate; crowds below and bright lamps. Some night glare and noise but subject legible. No visible watermark. Caption must identify festival gateway and2012 date, not actual historic ship or present layout.
